proof_body:
by
  intro a b c s t x ha hsx hxt hs ht
  rcases (hsx.trans hxt).eq_or_lt with hst | hst
  · have hxs : x = s := le_antisymm (by rw [hst]; exact hxt) hsx
    rw [hxs]
    exact hs
  · have key : (t - s) * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = (t - x) * (a * s ^ 2 + b * s + c) + (x - s) * (a * t ^ 2 + b * t + c) + (-a) * ((x - s) * ((t - x) * (t - s))) := by
      ring
    have h1 := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hxt) hs
    have h2 := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hsx) ht
    have h3 := mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 ha.le) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hsx) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hxt) (sub_pos.2 hst).le))
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have h4 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.2 hst) hn
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c s t x : ℝ), a < 0 → s ≤ x → x ≤ t → 0 ≤ a * s ^ 2 + b * s + c → 0 ≤ a * t ^ 2 + b * t + c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c
